title: A marketplace's catalog.json
description: A Claude Code marketplace's extensions as one file, for a page or a client to show without cloning the repository: written by @falkenslab/agent-kit-catalog from .claude-plugin/marketplace.json and each extension's plugin.json.

marketplace.description: The marketplace's name, as <extension>@<marketplace> names an extension.

version.description: Its plugin.json's, the same as its marketplace entry's.

description.description: In English: its marketplace entry's, else its plugin.json's.

descriptions.description: Its description per language, English among them; only when it has one in another language.

topics.description: Its plugin.json's keywords and its entry's tags, keywords and category, lowercased, without repeats.

readmes.description: Its README per language (README.md, README.es.md…), as URLs; only when it has one in another language.

capabilities.description: What it lets the agent do: its metadata["agent-kit"].capabilities as it declares them, texts in every language it gives.

requirements.description: The programs it needs on the computer: its metadata["agent-kit"].requirements as it declares them.

remote.description: The hosts its remote MCP servers talk to (type http or sse in its .mcp.json): what an agent sends there leaves the computer. Only when it has some.

servers.description: Its MCP servers (plugin.json's mcpServers, else .mcp.json): a package run with npx, bunx or uvx (its package, version and npm page), a program it brings (bundled: its command as written), a remote server (its transport and host), or another command (its name only). Never an argument's secret nor an env value.

skills.description: Its skills: each one's folder name and its SKILL.md's description, sorted by name.

commands.description: Its commands: each one's file name and its description, sorted by name.

agents.description: Its subagents: each one's file name and its description, sorted by name.

tools.description: The tools its metadata["agent-kit"] knows (labels, capabilities, readOnlyTools, confirmTools, serverConfirmTools), by short name: a static read, a running server may list more.

labels.description: Its label per language, {field} as written.

confirm.description: always: the person says yes before every call; server: its server asks the person itself.

kit.description: The agent-kit versions it works with, as its metadata["agent-kit"].kit says.
